   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006

- Earn $2,000 sustainability points once you meet the spending threshold within the qualifying period.

   ID: doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_010
   Score: 0.5892

- Net purchases (purchases minus returns/credits) that post within the qualifying period

- The $500 typically posts within two billing cycles after you meet the spending requirement

## Tips
- Set recurring bills and subscriptions on your card immediately after approval to reach $2,000 within 1 month(s)

   Score: 0.5704

- Make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening.
- After qualification, a $500 statement credit will be applied to your account.

- Only net purchases count; returns or credits reduce your qualifying total.
- Transactions must post to your account within 2 months to be included.

## Tracking and Fulfillment
- Track your progress toward the $10,000 requirement in your account dashboard.
- The $500 will appear on a future statement after qualification is confirmed.

## Tips for Success
- Plan larger purchases early in the period so they post within 2 months.
- Keep documentation of purchases in case a transaction posts later than expected.

4. Business Silver Rewards Card: Double Cash Back Promo
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012
   Score: 0.5204
   Content: ## Limited-time offer: double your cash back
New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

## How it works
- Travel and software purchases that normally earn 10.0% are multiplied by 2 during the promotional period
- Other purchases that normally earn 1.0% are multiplied by 2 during the promotional period
- The increased rewards rate is automatically applied to qualifying transactions; no separate enrollment is required

## Promo period
- Start date: 2024-11-14
- End date: 2025-11-14

- The 6-month window begins on your account opening date, not the promotional start date
- You must open your account during the promotional period to qualify
- Merchant category exclusions continue to apply (see Exceptions and Exclusions)
- Cash back is credited to your account at the end of each billing cycle consistent with program rules

5. Silver Zoom Card: New Customer Promo - 0% APR on Fuel Purchases
   ID: doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_010
   Score: 0.5180

- Channel fuel spend to participating stations during the promotional period to pair the financing benefit with eligible fuel savings
- Continue to make at least the minimum required payments by each statement due date to keep the promotional terms in effect

- Purchases you choose to carry will accrue interest at 0% during the promo period.
- Your statements will reflect the promotional rate for eligible balances within the first 12 months.

## After the Promo Period
- Any remaining or new carried balances will accrue interest at your standard APR of 20.49%.

## Managing the Transition
- Consider paying down larger balances before your 12‑month promo ends to minimize interest once the rate returns to 20.49%.
- Review your statement a cycle before the promo ends to plan payments accordingly.
